name: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd
title: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd - 532527 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 28% YoY to Rs 1,216.78 cr with EBITDA margin 17.1%, but forging utilisation near 70% and management guides capex only Rs 300-400 cr with Rs 400-500 cr debt cut in FY27.

utilisation.quote: the forging utilization, it's mentioned nearly 70% in Q4

capex.quote: we are not looking at capex of more than Rs. 300 to Rs. 400 crores maximum to the tune of Rs. 400 crores

triggers.quote: we are not looking at capex of more than Rs. 300 to Rs. 400 crores maximum

triggers.label: Energy cost pass-through pending
